flow.h: From your wearable to your policy in three steps
flow.1.p: Fitbit, Garmin, Whoop and Google Health Connect already hold your daily activity.
flow.2.p: We analyse your data, issue your risk rating and prepare a fair quote.
flow.3.p: A licensed insurer underwrites and issues your policy using your rating.
flow.note: We work from daily summaries, rated weekly and monthly. We are not another fitness tracker.
